title: One More, Says Dot
hook: It's bedtime, but Dot the puppy wants one more of everything.
blurb: One more jump in the leaves. One more splash in the puddle. One more bubble, one more story... Dot the spotty puppy is very good at one more. But Mum is getting sleepier and sleepier, and soon somebody else needs tucking in. A giggly join-in story for every small person who isn't tired yet.
coverAlt: Dot, a small white puppy with black spots, leaping joyfully into a pile of orange autumn leaves while her big spotty mum watches, smiling and a little tired

narrator.notes: Playful and bouncy for Dot, with a big excited 'One more!' every time so children can join in. Mum gets slower and yawnier page by page. The last page slow and whispery.

style: Premium contemporary picture-book illustration for toddlers: soft painterly 3D look, rounded expressive characters with big readable faces, warm lamp-light and golden autumn evening light, gentle film grain, bold simple compositions with lots of clear space, cosy British home and garden. Consistent characters on every page. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, signs or captions anywhere in the image.
world: A small family home and back garden in autumn, at the end of the day. The garden has a big pile of orange and red leaves under an apple tree, a muddy puddle on the path, a wooden gate. Inside: a white bathroom with a deep claw-foot tub full of bubbles, and a cosy bedroom corner with a big round squashy dog bed, a patchwork blanket and a little shelf of picture books with blank covers. Warm lamps; deep blue evening outside the windows.

cast.name: Dot
cast.look: Dot: a small, bouncy puppy with a round tummy, short white fur covered in black spots of all sizes (one big spot around her left eye), floppy black ears, a short waggy tail with a black tip, a pink tongue often poking out, and a red collar with a round bell. Huge, bright, mischievous brown eyes.

cast.name: Mum
cast.look: Mum: a big, gentle, grown-up dog of the same breed as Dot, about four times Dot's size, white with black spots and long soft black ears, a calm kind face, a blue collar. Gets droopier and sleepier through the story.

pages.heading: This Is Dot
pages.text:
This is Dot.

Dot is a puppy with a lot of spots.

It is nearly bedtime.

"Time for bed, Dot," says Mum.

Dot wags her tail.

"One more!" says Dot.

"One more what?" says Mum.

"One more JUMP!"
pages.imageAlt: Dot the spotty puppy wagging her tail in the garden at sunset while Mum calls her in from the back door

art.shot: Medium-wide view of the back garden, Mum at the door, Dot in the foreground.
art.prompt: Golden evening light in the back garden. Dot stands in the foreground, tail wagging so fast it blurs, tongue out, eyes fixed on a big pile of orange leaves under the apple tree. Mum stands in the open back door with a warm lit kitchen behind her, calling Dot in. Cheerful, cheeky and warm.

pages.heading: Boing!
pages.text:
Boing! Dot jumps in the leaves.

Crunch, crunch, crunch!

Leaves in her ears. Leaves on her nose.

"Now bed," says Mum.

"One more!" says Dot.

"One more SPLASH!"
pages.imageAlt: Dot leaping into a pile of autumn leaves, with leaves flying everywhere and one stuck on her nose

art.shot: Close and low, Dot mid-leap, leaves exploding outwards.
art.prompt: Dot leaps into the big pile of orange and red leaves, all four paws in the air, ears flying up. Leaves burst out everywhere; one leaf is stuck on her nose and another sits on her head like a hat. Mum's legs and calm face are just visible at the edge of the frame. Joyful, bouncy, funny.

pages.heading: Splosh!
pages.text:
Splosh! Dot jumps in the puddle.

Mud on Dot. Mud on Mum.

Mud, mud, MUD!

"One more!" says Dot.

"Oh no," says Mum. "No more mud. It's BATH time!"
pages.imageAlt: Dot landing in a muddy puddle and splashing mud all over Mum, who looks surprised

art.shot: Side view at puddle level, Dot landing, Mum beside the puddle.
art.prompt: Dot lands in a big brown puddle on the garden path with a huge splash. Mud flies up in a fan and splatters across Mum's white spotty side and face; Mum stands very still with her eyes shut and a patient, comical expression. Dot is grinning, covered in mud. The sky is turning deep blue. Very funny, gentle.

pages.heading: Pop!
pages.text:
In the bath, Dot pops bubbles.

Pop! Pop! Pop!

"Now bed," says Mum.

"One more!" says Dot.

"One more bubble?" says Mum.

One big bubble floats up, up, up.

POP! Right on Mum's nose.
pages.imageAlt: Dot in a bath full of bubbles, popping them, as one big bubble pops on Mum's nose

art.shot: Medium view over the side of the bathtub.
art.prompt: Dot sits in a deep white claw-foot bath, buried up to her ears in bubbles, paw raised to pop one. Mum leans over the side of the bath, clean now, and a big round bubble has just burst on the end of her nose, making her blink. Warm bathroom lamp-light, steam, soft towels. Silly and cosy.

pages.heading: One More Story
pages.text:
Dot is in bed.

She is warm and dry and fluffy.

"Night night, Dot," says Mum.

"One more!" says Dot.

"One more what?" says Mum.

"One more STORY!"

So Mum gets a book.
pages.imageAlt: Fluffy, freshly dried Dot sitting up in her round dog bed as Mum brings over a picture book

art.shot: Cosy medium view of the bedroom corner.
art.prompt: Dot sits up in a big round squashy dog bed with a patchwork blanket, her fur extra fluffy and puffed up after the bath. Mum carries a picture book with a plain cover in her mouth towards the bed. A lamp glows amber; deep blue night through the window. Warm, cosy, a little bit cheeky.

pages.heading: Droopy and Floppy
pages.text:
Mum reads one more story.

And one more.

And one more.

Mum's eyes go droopy.

Mum's ears go floppy.

Mum's head goes down, down... bump.

SNORE!

Mum is asleep!
pages.imageAlt: Mum fast asleep with her head on the open book while Dot stares at her, wide awake

art.shot: Close view of the dog bed, both characters filling the frame.
art.prompt: Mum has fallen asleep sitting up beside the dog bed, her head flopped onto the open picture book, ears drooping over it, mouth open in a big snore. Dot sits bolt upright in the bed, wide awake, staring at Mum with big surprised eyes. A pile of picture books with blank covers beside them. Lamp-light. Very funny and gentle.

pages.heading: Night Night, Mum
pages.text:
Dot looks at Mum.

Lick! Dot licks Mum's nose. Mum just snores.

Dot pulls the blanket over Mum.

Pat, pat.

"Night night, Mum," says Dot.
pages.imageAlt: Dot pulling the patchwork blanket over her sleeping Mum with her teeth

art.shot: Medium view, slightly lower and calmer than before.
art.prompt: Dot tugs the patchwork blanket over sleeping Mum with her teeth, very carefully, tail wagging gently. Mum is still asleep, slumped over the open picture book, with a peaceful smile. The lamp is lower now and the room is dimmer, deep blue at the window. Tender, sweet and quiet.

pages.heading: The Very Last One More
pages.text:
Dot curls up close to Mum. Warm. Soft.

Dot's eyes go droopy.

Dot's ears go floppy.

"One more..." says Dot.

"One more... cuddle."

And that was the very last one more.
pages.imageAlt: Dot asleep curled up against Mum under the patchwork blanket, in a dim cosy room

art.shot: Soft close-up from above, both dogs curled together.
art.prompt: Dot is curled up fast asleep against Mum's chest under the patchwork blanket, her ears flopped, tiny smile, one paw over her nose. Mum's big head rests protectively around her. The lamp is off; only soft moonlight from the window. Very dim, soft, low-contrast, warm and peaceful.
